RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Spokane, WA operates under a strong mayor-council form of government. [5, 10, 15] The city has a Mayor, a City Council President, six City Council Members, and three Municipal Court Judges. [18] While the names of the Mayor and City Council members were found, the names of the three Municipal Court Judges were not available in the provided search results. One source indicated a vacant City Council position for District 2 [3], but a more recent directory listed Shelby Lambdin for that role [9], so Shelby Lambdin has been included.
